notes:
Built on the REDESIGN 2 master (Tue Oct 27, batch D4). Parent: the refitted tires overlay (a chair-style lane booked by time; a car waited on or left; a van that comes to the customer); not edited. No old flowchart existed (a new profession), so the plug-in is the trade's norm and every price says 'example'.
Two companies: Lee's Inspections (flow A, 48 Station Rd, 2 lanes) and Lee Car Check (flow B, the van; kinds of work: Lee Pre-Buy and Lee Fleet Check). Staff: Cal and Joy (station), Gil and Ana (van). Alex lives at 26 Maple Ct.
Licenses are USED (the first work in this batch that has them): the station license and each inspector's certificate, where the state's rules require them (S1-60 '1 A license' and S2-28 '1 Yes, each one' stay; the 'no license' branches are off). Example numbers are EX-style (EX-2087, EX-3310). Nothing names a state.
Money A: list|none|counter (main: the combined combined inspection, $50) and list|none|bill (car left; bill with READY). Nothing is ever taken before at the station, no deposit, no cancel or no-show fee. Money B: list|card|bill (main: a pre-purchase inspection of a used car at the seller's place, $229 with the $89 trip fee in it) and visit|card|bill (a fleet inspection at a business lot, counted and priced at the visit). The card is saved for the $89 trip fee and charged only for a late cancel or a no-show, only on Sam's yes, never more than that fee.
The master's A numbers fit the services ($50 combined; $40 emissions; $25 safety; $20 headlight aim; $55 commercial; $140 pre-purchase at the station) and flow B keeps $89 and the $245 fleet quote ($165 vans + $80 trucks).
The result (pass or fail), its readings and any certificate number never go in a text (a test result): READY says 'your inspection is done', and the result is on the secure page and at the counter. Texts about a re-test never say pass or fail.
Safety: stop words are someone hurt or a crash, a fire or smoke, someone dizzy or sick from fumes (911, no booking). Brakes that fail, a fuel leak or strong fuel smell, a loose wheel and steering that won't hold the road are don't-drive words (the van comes to the car). A request to skip the test, change a result or get a certificate without the test is refused and the owner told (pf.safety.refuse).
Who must not be booked: a car being bought is checked only with the seller's OK (own step B4-x01 / B4-x02); registration, proof of insurance and the key are required at the visit (A8-02 kept: nothing starts without them, no fee). A teen's car is booked by a parent.
A check-engine light that is on: own step A4-x01 / A4-x02 tells Alex plainly the car may not pass; it is booked anyway.
Never sent now: the sent-now branches are off; the on-call lines say none.
Off as work this trade never has: video or phone, seats, stays, forms, contracts, plans, packs, insurance, stages, a child left, repairs sold through Rosie.
Aftercare: the free 30-day re-test (own step A10-x01; B10-01 says it too); the days and what is free are the state form's switch (pf.rules.retest_rule).
Not sure (for the verifier): $229 for a pre-purchase check at the seller's place and the 30-day free re-test are the example station's own; whether a state allows a certificate away from the station is a switch (pf.rules.mobile_testing), so the fleet visit is written as a priced check; the S1-13 and S1-14 per-path lines still show the master's example (paid in full, a $20 fee card) that no overlay can change without money words per path (MASTER line in the log).
